title: Biofunctionalization of porcine-derived collagen matrix using enamel matrix derivative and platelet-rich fibrin: influence on mature endothelial cell characteristics in vitro
authors: Park JS, Pabst AM, Ackermann M, Moergel M, Jung J, Kasaj A. Clin Oral Investig. 2018 Mar;22(2):909- 917. doi: 10.1007/s00784-017-2170-7.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “HUVEC cell characteristics were overall improved by EMD-and PRF-modified PDCM. Adsorbed bioactive molecules to the PDCM surface may have contributed to a more preferable environment to surrounding cells” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
